patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.quoteLong: I've been throwing up and having diarrhea since yesterday — can't keep water down. A few of us got sick after the potluck. I'm lightheaded when I stand up.
clinical.presentationShort: 30yo F — 24h vomiting/diarrhea, poor PO, dry mucous membranes, mild orthostasis, afebrile — viral gastroenteritis w/ dehydration.
clinical.presentationLong: 30-year-old female with a day of vomiting and diarrhea after a shared meal, poor oral intake, dry mucous membranes, and mild orthostasis — viral gastroenteritis with dehydration.

diagnosis.disposition: Acute → antiemetic, IV fluids, electrolytes, reassess PO; discharge if tolerating.
diagnosis.why: Vomiting + diarrhea + can't tolerate PO = dehydration. Antiemetic, rehydrate, reassess. Watch for bloody stool / severe pain.

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: slumped, clutching her stomach, holding an emesis bag
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a white 30-year-old woman, pale and washed-out, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: slumped, one hand on her stomach, holding a small emesis bag. Expression: queasy and drained. Clearly visible: a hand on the stomach and an emesis bag. No text, no logos.
